title: Epic mood trailer
summary: A fast-cut p5.js trailer with the mood of a long voyage and homecoming.
description: The mood draws on the long voyage and homecoming of classical epics. Visuals are generated with p5.js and cut into a fast-paced trailer under a minute long, with narration and subtitles.
